updateNotes: Recording (first test version): press the red dot or Record key, or hold OK, and choose how long; hold OK on a programme in the Guide to record it now or later. New Recordings tab. When a channel stops working, Nura plays its HD, SD or backup copy. Optional Wide guide style (Settings > EPG > TV Guide). Fixed: the whole payment QR code shows, Add Profile opens the add form, no more closing on older boxes after a network change.
